alert.description_short: Displays an alert dialog with a message to the user.

align.description_short: Sets alignment of content within the element.
align.example:
Left aligned
Center aligned
Right aligned

valign.description_short: Sets the vertical alignment of content within the element.
valign.example: Top aligned Middle aligned Bottom aligned

bgcolor.description_short: Sets the background color of the element.
bgcolor.example: This div has a light blue background

bgimage.description_short: Sets the background image of the element.

border.description_short: Sets the border of the element.
border.example: This div has a black border

boxshadow.description_short: Applies a shadow effect to the element.
boxshadow.example: This div has a shadow

click.description_short: Executes an action or expression when the element is clicked.

cursor.description_short: Sets the cursor when hovering over the element.
cursor.example: Default Pointer Text Move Wait Crosshair Not Allowed Help Progress Grab Grabbing Cell Copy Alias Zoom In Zoom Out Col Resize Row Resize N Resize S Resize E Resize W Resize NE Resize NW Resize SE Resize SW Resize

confirm.description_short: Shows a confirmation dialog to the user.

data-src.description_short: Specifies the source URL or endpoint for data to be fetched and bound to the element.

data-iterate.description_short: Indicates that the element should iterate over an array from the data source.

data-loader.description_short: Specifies an element to show while data is loading and hide when complete.

data-onempty.description_short: Executes actions when the fetched data is empty. Accepts any action expression supported by app.call.
data-onempty.example: No results found

data-onnotempty.description_short: Executes actions when the fetched data is not empty. Accepts any action expression supported by app.call.
data-onnotempty.example: Not empty!

data-get.description_short: Retrieves and displays a value from the current bound data context.

data-set.description_short: Assigns a value from the data context to a variable or target element.

data-bind.description_short: Binds an element directly to a data variable or expression.

data-bindpayload.description_short: Maps a value from a form payload into a bound variable or field.

data-srcjoin.description_short: Fetches and merges an additional data source into the same binding context.

data-header.description_short: Sets custom HTTP headers for the data source request.

data-onsuccess.description_short: Executes actions when the data source request completes successfully.

data-onerror.description_short: Executes actions when the data source request fails.
data-onerror.example: Something went wrong!

data-onfinish.description_short: Executes actions when data processing is complete, regardless of success or failure.

data-ongetload.description_short: Executes actions when a data-get value finishes loading.

data-wait.description_short: Defines the delay in milliseconds before executing the data request.

data-ttl.description_short: Sets cache lifetime (time-to-live) in milliseconds for the bound data source.

data-filteritem.description_short: Filters the data array by matching a key to a value.

data-filterkey.description_short: Specifies which key in the response object to apply the filter on.

data-sort.description_short: Sorts the data array by the specified key.

data-sortorder.description_short: Sets the sort direction: ascending (default) or descending.

data-merge.description_short: Specifies keys to merge from a joined data source into the primary response.

data-onstatus.description_short: Shows an element when the response status does not match 200.
data-onstatus.example: Server returned an error status

data-onkeyempty.description_short: Executes actions when the resolved iterate key is missing or has no items.

data-replace.description_short: Transforms values in the response data before rendering.

data-credentials.description_short: Sends cookies and authentication credentials with the data request.

escape.description_short: Escapes HTML or special characters to display as plain text.

flex.description_short: Sets flex properties for the element.
flex.example: 1 2 3

flexdirection.example:
1 2 3
1 2 3

flexitem.description_short: Sets properties of a flex item.
flexitem.example: Flex 1 Flex 2

font.example: This text uses a custom font

grid.description_short: Sets the element display to grid.
grid.example: 1 2 3 4

height.description_short: Sets the height of the element.

hrefhost.description_short: Sets the base URL based on host match.

if.description_short: Conditionally executes actions based on a comparison.

include.description_short: Includes another internal HTML file or page fragment into the element.

insertbeforebegin.description_short: Inserts new content immediately before the element.

insertafterbegin.description_short: Inserts new content just inside the element, before its first child.

insertbeforeend.description_short: Inserts new content just inside the element, after its last child.

insertafterend.description_short: Inserts new content immediately after the element.

justifycontent.description_short: Aligns flex items along the main axis.
justifycontent.example: 1 2 3

keyboard-key.description_short: Defines one or more keys that trigger the element's action. Multiple keys can be separated by a semicolon.

lineheight.description_short: Sets the height of text lines.

lowercase.example: THIS TEXT WILL APPEAR IN LOWERCASE LETTERS

margin.example: This div has 20px margin on all sides

minheight.example: This div cannot be shorter than 100px

minwidth.example: This div cannot be narrower than 200px

maxwidth.example: This div cannot be wider than 400px

mouseout.description_short: Executes an action when the mouse leaves the element.

mouseover.description_short: Executes an action when the mouse enters the element.

navigate-go.description_short: Programmatically triggers navigation as if a user clicked a link. Loads the target page via the Navigate module into the specified container without a full page reload.

onconfirm.description_short: Triggered when the user confirms an action in a confirmation dialog.

onconfirmvalue.description_short: Triggered when a confirmation dialog is accepted; typically used to pass a value or trigger chained actions.
onconfirmvalue.example: <button click="confirm:[Are you sure?]" onconfirmvalue="true;settext:[Confirmed with yes]">Delete Item</button>

onclicked.description_short: Triggered when the element is clicked.
onclicked.example: <button click="sethtml:[Button clicked!]" onclicked="insertbeforeend:[ Added after]">Click me</button>

onenabled.description_short: Triggered when the element or feature becomes enabled.

ondisabled.description_short: Triggered when the element or feature becomes disabled.

onfocused.description_short: Triggered when the element gains focus.

onblur.description_short: Triggered when the element loses focus.

onhide.description_short: Triggered when the element is hidden.

onshow.description_short: Triggered when the element is shown.
onshow.example: Hidden Panel

onsubmitted.description_short: Triggered when a form is submitted.

placeholder.description_short: Displays placeholder text when the element is empty.

placeholdercolor.description_short: Sets the color of the placeholder text.

resize.description_short: Sets resize behavior of the element.
resize.example:
<textarea resize="both" width="200px" height="100px">You can resize me</textarea>
<textarea resize="none" width="200px" height="100px">You cannot resize me</textarea>

resetvalue.description_short: Resets the value of the element.

runorder.description_short: Runs attributes in the specified order inside the element.

setaction.description_short: Sets or changes the action URL of a form.

setmax.description_short: Sets the maximum value of a progress bar or input range element.

setattr.description_short: Sets an attribute on the element.

sethref.description_short: Sets the href attribute of the element.

setqueryhref.description_short: Updates the href attribute of the element with operation support.
setqueryhref.example:
Next Page
Previous Page
Zoom In
Zoom Out
Add 5 Points
Subtract 3 Points

setvalue.description_short: Sets the value of the element.

setid.description_short: Sets the id of the element.

setname.description_short: Sets the name of the element.

setsrc.description_short: Sets the source of the image.

slice.description_short: Extracts part of the content by index.

start.description_short: Starts an attribute or process on the element.

stop.description_short: Stops an attribute or process on the element.

split.description_short: Splits content by delimiter and returns a part.

togglevalue.description_short: Toggles the value of the element.

trim.description_short: Removes whitespace from the start and end of content.

trimleft.description_short: Removes characters from the start of content.

trimright.description_short: Removes characters from the end of content.

uppercase.example: This text will appear in uppercase letters

width.description_short: Sets the width of the element.
width.example:
This div is 200px wide
This div is 50% of its container's width

wordbreak.description_short: Sets how words break in text.
wordbreak.example:
Thisisaverylongwordthatmayoverflow.
Thisisaverylongwordthatmayoverflow.
This is a long sentence that will not break words in CJK text.

whitespace.example:
This text has normal whitespace.
This text preserves all spaces and line breaks.
This text will not wrap onto the next line, even if it overflows.

zindex.description_short: Sets the stacking order of the element.
zindex.example: On top Behind

zoom.description_short: Sets zoom scale of the element.
zoom.example: This text is zoomed in by 150%

absolute.description_short: Sets the element to absolute positioning.
absolute.example: Absolute

alignitems.description_short: Aligns flex items along the cross axis.
alignitems.example: Centered

alignself.description_short: Overrides the align-items value for a specific flex item.
alignself.example: Normal Self end

bindappend.description_short: Binds and appends data from another element.

block.description_short: Sets the element display to block.
block.example: This span is now block-level

borderbottom.description_short: Sets the bottom border of the element.

borderleft.description_short: Sets the left border of the element.

borderright.description_short: Sets the right border of the element.

bordertop.description_short: Sets the top border of the element.

clone.description_short: Clones an element's content into the current element.

fixed.description_short: Sets the element to fixed positioning.
fixed.example: Fixed header

flexgrow.description_short: Sets the flex grow factor of a flex item.
flexgrow.example: Fixed Grows

float.description_short: Sets the float direction of the element.

gridarea.description_short: Sets the grid area of an element.

gridcolumn.description_short: Sets the grid column position of an element.

gridcolumns.description_short: Defines the column template for a grid container.
gridcolumns.example: 100px 1fr 2fr

gridrow.description_short: Sets the grid row position of an element.
gridrow.example: Spans 2 rows 2 3

gridrows.description_short: Defines the row template for a grid container.

inherit.description_short: Sets a CSS property to inherit from its parent.

initial.description_short: Sets a CSS property to its initial value.

inline.description_short: Sets the element display to inline.

Inline-block
Inline-block

keyboard-action.description_short: Enables an element to respond to keyboard keys. Works with keyboard-key and keyboard-word.

left.description_short: Sets the left position of a positioned element.
left.example: Left 20px

letterspacing.description_short: Sets the spacing between letters in text.
letterspacing.example: This text has extra letter spacing

maprun.description_short: Maps and runs actions based on rules.

maptext.description_short: Maps text values based on rules.

maxheight.example: This div cannot be taller than 100px

move.description_short: Moves an element into another element.
move.example:
Target
Move me
Auto moved

onsethtml.description_short: Triggered when the element's HTML content is changed.
onsethtml.example: Original

onvaluechange.description_short: Triggered when the value of an input element changes.

onaftervaluechange.description_short: Triggered after the value of an element has changed.

onbeforevaluechange.description_short: Triggered before the value of an element changes.

ontoggle.description_short: Triggered when an element is toggled.

overflow.description_short: Sets overflow behavior of the element.
overflow.example: This content is clipped when it overflows the container boundaries.

overflowx.example: This text is too long to fit and will scroll horizontally.

prependattr.description_short: Prepends content to an attribute value.

relative.description_short: Sets the element to relative positioning.

right.description_short: Sets the right position of a positioned element.
right.example: Right 20px

scroll.description_short: Scrolls to an element or position.

Top content

Bottom

table.description_short: Sets the element display to table.
table.example: Cell 1 Cell 2

toggledisplay.description_short: Toggles the display of an element between visible and hidden.

top.description_short: Sets the top position of a positioned element.
top.example: Top 20px

unset.description_short: Resets a CSS property to its inherited or initial value.

outline.description_short: Sets the outline of the element.

outlineoffset.description_short: Sets the offset of the outline from the element edge.
outlineoffset.example: Offset outline

outlinestyle.description_short: Sets the style of the outline.

outlinewidth.description_short: Sets the width of the outline.

movebefore.description_short: Moves an element before a target element.

moveafter.description_short: Moves an element after a target element.

movebeforebegin.description_short: Moves an element to before the beginning of a target element.

moveafterbegin.description_short: Moves an element to after the beginning of a target element (first child).

movebeforeend.description_short: Moves an element to before the end of a target element (last child).

moveafterend.description_short: Moves an element to after the end of a target element.

rundelay.description_short: Delays execution of an action by a specified number of milliseconds.

runrepeat.description_short: Repeats execution of an action at a specified interval in milliseconds.

runattr.description_short: Runs a specific attribute on the element programmatically.

loader.description_short: Shows a loader element while content is loading and hides it when complete.

metadata.description_short: Sets metadata (e.g. meta tags) on the document head.

insertcontent.description_short: Inserts content from the element's original content into modified output.

inheritattributes.description_short: Inherits attributes from a parent or source element.

inheritcontent.description_short: Inherits content from a parent or source element.

bindfieldreloadcontent.description_short: Reloads the element content when a bound field value changes.

rightclick.description_short: Executes an action when the element is right-clicked.

onsettext.description_short: Triggered when the element's text content is changed via settext.

onformsubmit.description_short: Triggered when a form submit event occurs on the element.

onreset.description_short: Triggered when an element is reset to its original state.

onbindglobalchange.description_short: Triggered when a bound global variable changes.

onmouseoverif.description_short: Conditionally triggers an action when the mouse enters the element.

onmouseoutif.description_short: Conditionally triggers an action when the mouse leaves the element.
onmouseoutif.example: Move out

onunselected.description_short: Triggered when an element becomes unselected.

iterate.description_short: Repeats the element's content a specified number of times or iterates over matched elements, extracting their attributes and content into template variables.
iterate.example:
• Item {i}
Home About Contact
{index} {name}

{alt}

iterate-skip.description_short: Excludes an element from being duplicated during iteration.

animate-start.description_short: Starts a CSS keyframe animation on the element.
animate-start.example: Animated box

animate-stop.description_short: Stops a running CSS keyframe animation on the element.

animate-key.description_short: Defines keyframe percentages for the animation (semicolon-separated).

animate-transform.description_short: Defines transform values for each keyframe (semicolon-separated).

animate-easing.description_short: Sets the easing function for the animation.

animate-duration.description_short: Sets the duration of the animation.

animate-delay.description_short: Sets the delay before the animation starts.

animate-direction.description_short: Sets the direction of the animation playback.
animate-direction.example: Ping pong

animate-iteration.description_short: Sets the number of times the animation repeats.

canvas-grad.description_short: Applies a gradient to the canvas element.

overlay-dialog.description_short: Opens an overlay dialog with specified content.
overlay-dialog.example:
Dialog Title

Dialog content here.

overlay-bind.description_short: Binds overlay content to a data source or element.

auth-protect.description_short: Protects an element or page requiring authentication.
auth-protect.example: Protected content only visible when authenticated

navigate-onloaded.description_short: Executes actions when a navigated page has finished loading.

navigate-pushstate.description_short: Pushes a new URL state to the browser history without full navigation.

screen-layout.description_short: Sets a layout mode based on the current screen size.

screen-xxs.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'xxs' breakpoint.

screen-xs.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'xs' breakpoint.

screen-sm.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'sm' breakpoint.

screen-md.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'md' breakpoint.

screen-lg.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'lg' breakpoint.

screen-xl.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'xl' breakpoint.

screen-xxl.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'xxl' breakpoint.

screen-xxxl.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'xxxl' breakpoint.

screen-wide.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'wide' breakpoint.

screen-ultra.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'ultra' breakpoint.

screen-cinema.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'cinema' breakpoint.

screen-mega.description_short: Triggers an action when window width matches the 'mega' breakpoint.

globalize-get.description_short: Gets the localized translation for the element content or a specified key.

globalize-set.description_short: Sets the active locale/language and reloads translations.

globalize-target.description_short: Specifies which attribute to set the translated value into (defaults to sethtml).

globalize-onsetload.description_short: Triggered when the globalize set operation has loaded new translations.

keyboard-word.description_short: Specifies a word sequence that triggers an action when typed.
keyboard-word.example: <input keyboard-word="hello" keyboard-action="alert:[You typed hello!]" placeholder="Type hello">

keyboard-finalizer.description_short: Specifies a key required to finalize a word sequence action.
keyboard-finalizer.example: <input keyboard-word="go" keyboard-finalizer="Enter" keyboard-action="navigate-go:[home]" placeholder="Type go + Enter">

keyboard-scope.description_short: Limits where the keyboard action applies (e.g. to a specific element).

keyboard-translate.description_short: Maps a key to a replacement character in an input or text element.

keyboard-untranslate.description_short: Removes a previously translated character from an input or text element.

math-bind.description_short: Binds a mathematical expression result to a variable.

math-compute.description_short: Computes a mathematical expression and sets the result.

math-round.description_short: Rounds a numeric value to a specified number of decimals.

chronotize-get.description_short: Gets a relative time or age value from a date.

data-bindheader.description_short: Binds a response header value to a variable.

form-invalid.description_short: Specifies a target element and message to display on invalid form input.

form-throttle.description_short: Throttles form submissions by a specified number of milliseconds.

ignorepayload.description_short: Prevents sending the payload for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests when set.

storage-bind.description_short: Binds an element to a storage key and re-renders on changes.

storage-iterate.description_short: Iterates over an array or object in the bound storage data.

storage-iterate-skip.description_short: Excludes an element from being duplicated during storage iteration.
storage-iterate-skip.example: • Add new item above

storage-get.description_short: Gets a value from the current storage item and displays it.

storage-set.description_short: Sets a value from the current storage item into an element attribute or variable.

storage-onempty.description_short: Shows an element when the bound storage data is empty.
storage-onempty.example: No items yet

storage-bindlocal.description_short: Binds a localStorage value to a variable on the element.

storage-bindsession.description_short: Binds a sessionStorage value to a variable on the element.

storage-localadd.description_short: Adds a value to an array in localStorage.

storage-localupdate.description_short: Updates a value at a path in localStorage.

storage-localremove.description_short: Removes a value or key from localStorage.

storage-sessionadd.description_short: Adds a value to an array in sessionStorage.

storage-sessionupdate.description_short: Updates a value at a path in sessionStorage.

storage-sessionremove.description_short: Removes a value or key from sessionStorage.

storage-cookieget.description_short: Gets a value from a browser cookie.

storage-cookie-days.description_short: Sets the expiry in days for a cookie.

storage-cookie-path.description_short: Sets the path for a cookie.

storage-cookie-secure.description_short: Marks a cookie as secure (HTTPS only).

storage-cookie-samesite.description_short: Sets the SameSite policy for a cookie.
